proved_exact: The 135 maximal chamber K4s collapse objectwise to 45 eight-point orbits, three pairwise-disjoint K4 frames per octad.
Octad disjointness is SRG(45,12,3,3), and the 45 centered octad vectors form a rank-24 two-distance tight frame.
The 135 frames are exactly the 135 Lagrangian three-spaces of W(5,2), restricted to the 36 anisotropic points.
The 135x36 incidence matrix has binary rank 29; its dual is the seven-dimensional affine restriction code with weights 0,16,20,36.
A frame stabilizer is C2^3 semidirect S4 of order 192, with an explicit S4 complement and the W(D4) order census.
The central quotient extension is nontrivial: the cocycle coefficient system has rank 95 and augmented rank 96.
The frame normalizer has order 576 and the full outer stabilizer has order 1152; the latter is explicitly conjugate to the 24-short-root action of W(F4).

No common outer involution inverts the exact four order-three generators; every color-split rank-eight factorization has at least 16 noncommuting edges, exceeding the seven allowed by a string diagram.
The 45 octad axes obey m0(u,u)=36u and m1(u,u)=-216u; no parameter gives the Monster 2A Majorana non-axis spectrum {0,1/4,1/32}.
Every even integral rank-24 Gram matrix is an integral graph section of II(24,24); E8^3 is constructed explicitly as a positive unimodular child.
No U4(2)-equivariant positive-definite unimodular graph polarization exists.
external_premises: The Leech lattice exists and is an even unimodular rootless rank-24 lattice; combined with the proved graph-polarization formula this gives a noncanonical rootless section.
